    Weak positivity makes an upper-triangular Cartan matrix thin #

    For a nonnegative upper-unitriangular integral Cartan matrix, weak positivity of the inverse-Cartan quadratic form forces every matrix entry to be at most one. The proof truncates a projective column at a chosen row and subtracts the corresponding unit vector.
